subject: Mobile Development
title: The Danger Hiptop: Sidekick Culture
description: A tiny lesson with a big payoff: The Danger Hiptop: Sidekick Culture.

hook.text: Before iPhones, American teenagers were obsessed with the T-Mobile Sidekick.

buildup.text: Its screen flipped up to reveal a full keyboard. AIM instant messaging worked natively.

discovery.text: Celebrities like Paris Hilton made it a cultural icon. It was the cool phone of 2004.

twist.text: Andy Rubin co-founded the company that made it. He later created Android at Google.

climax.text: The Sidekick proved that phones were social devices, not just communication tools.

punchline.text: The Sidekick's creator went on to build Android.

quiz.question: Who co-created both the Sidekick and Android?
